help: copy this machine's own sessions of every served provider into the stage, tmp/stage/input/<provider>/code/machine-transport/<machine>, which corpus-yoga agent promote takes into the store

args.name: --provider
args.help: every session of ONE served provider (the named totality of that provider's live store), or with --id one of them

args.name: --id
args.help: one session of the provider --provider names, by a uuid prefix matching exactly one; requires --provider - a uuid's shape does not say whose it is, as the browser capture's --id says

args.name: --all
args.help: every session of every served provider whose live store is mounted (the whole outbox of each)
